case_title: MISSION EDGARDO V DBA AAVIZ PLANNER VS GARCES ELSIE

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY MISSION EDGARDO V DBA AAVIZ PLANNER AS TO DEFENDANT GARCES ELSIE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-28-1992 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 04
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT GARCES ELSIE

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MISSION EDGARDO V DBA AAVIZ PLANNER IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT GARCES ELSIE DEFT AGREED IN WRITING TO SATISFY OBLIGATION OF $2781 OF PLTF ON TERMS OF $200 P/MO PYMTS ON 15TH STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
